research_question: At each Jan 1, predict the first financial/audit ST or *ST among currently normal nonfinancial A-share companies.
training_landmarks: Jan 1 annually from 2016 (first complete origin supported by local daily data starting 2015), strictly before prediction year; repeated companies retained with company bootstrap
feature_cutoff: strictly before the Jan 1 landmark; do not use future ST announcement features
target_cause: first financial/audit ST or *ST announcement, supported by raw coded reasons or existing raw-matched adjudication
competing_cause: other first ST or direct final delisting before first target ST; preserve subtype privately
unknown_cause: censor at the unresolved transition, never label normal
origin_eligibility: A-share, nonfinancial industry on an available prior report, normal last trading status within the preceding 31 calendar days, no known prior ST history in the linked company history
training_censor: min(24 calendar months after landmark, strictly before the historical cutoff, last documented observation/ambiguous transition)
unsupported: 2025 24-month performance remains NA; retain right censoring for all other incomplete observations
input: 48 financial + 24 market + 3 data-quality fields; preserve native missing state; audit/entry features observed only at ST entry are excluded
financial_vintage: current CSMAR exports; known corrections use their disclosure dates; original historical disclosure versions not certified, hence PROVISIONAL
shrinkage: raw direct-parent AJ, unique in-bag companies / (unique in-bag companies + 10); no recursive/repeated shrinkage
pilot: one 4-tree numerical/resource pilot on training data only, not used for model or parameter selection
aggregation: average the 3 seeds' company CIF predictions within each year, equivalent to 96 equal-weight trees
metrics: Top20 and Top25 known independent event capture
evaluation_rules: Competing events before horizon are known non-target outcomes; censored-before-horizon cases excluded from binary AUC/AP, retained in IPCW Brier and AJ. Horizon-specific censoring survival and support reported. Pooled metrics recalculated from combined predictions; annual Top fractions chosen before pooling.
uncertainty: 1000 company-level fixed-prediction paired bootstrap, seed 2026110501; common company draws preserve repeated-year dependence
numerical_checks: all train/evaluation rows, all native times, both causes: CIF probability/monotonicity, exact q2 expansion, component sum, save/load; native missing and temporal censoring tests
compute: independent raw-file scans and year/seed fits use two-node Slurm; single-threaded workers; no distributed single fit
preservation: No post-ST model, current pointer, old prediction, raw dataset or prior report is modified; no feature, seed, hyperparameter or calibration search.
privacy: company identifiers, original values, thresholds, models and individual predictions remain private; publish only aggregate reports, code, hashes and configuration

audit_before_freeze.planned_2012_start_infeasible: Local daily exports begin 2015; no 2012-2015 normal-at-origin evidence. All these rows excluded, not fabricated.
audit_before_freeze.scope: Local BDT records verified logically identical to researcher-accepted complete nonfinancial snapshot; prior exact-match announcement/reason adjudications reused.
